launches.notes: 2024 Creta facelift launched at Rs 10.99 lakh (E 1.5 petrol MT); press coverage, not official price list.
Creta N Line introduced as separate performance derivative (N8/N10 trims, 1.5 turbo-petrol MT/DCT); entry N8 MT at Rs 16.82 lakh.

Creta Electric launched at Bharat Mobility Global Expo 2025; entry Executive 42kWh at introductory Rs 17.99 lakh.
